description: Fetches members who voted on a Trello card; requires an existing card ID, the Voting Power-Up to be active on the board, and members to have voted; returns member details, not vote counts.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of member fields to return, or 'all'. Valid fields: `avatarHash`, `bio`, `bioData`, `confirmed`, `fullName`, `idPremOrgsAdmin`, `initials`, `memberType`, `products`, `status`, `url`, `username`.
fields.title: Fields

idCard.description: The ID or short link of the Trello card.
idCard.title: Id Card

name: get_cards_members_voted_by_id_card

members.description: List of members who voted on the card.
members.title: Members

Member.description: Represents a Trello member who voted on a card

activityBlocked.description: Indicates whether the member's activity is blocked.
activityBlocked.title: Activity Blocked

avatarHash.description: Hash identifier for the member's avatar image.
avatarHash.title: Avatar Hash

avatarUrl.description: Full URL to the member's avatar image.
avatarUrl.title: Avatar Url

fullName.description: Full display name of the member.
fullName.title: Full Name

id.description: Unique identifier of the member (TrelloID, 24 character hexadecimal string).
id.title: Id

idMemberReferrer.description: TrelloID of the member who referred this member, or null if not referred.
idMemberReferrer.title: Id Member Referrer

initials.description: Initials derived from the member's name.
initials.title: Initials

username.description: Username of the member on Trello.
username.title: Username

Member.title: Member
